feeds.title: Slime Obsidian » ASMR
feeds.description: In the following segment, the Slime Obsidian blog talks about the usage of slime in the ASMR community and how it has allowed the user to experience various textures and sounds to induce relaxation and encourage calmness. Slime Obsidian started in 2017 when founder Jacob decided to create a slime account after realizing how satisfying slime was the year before. With over a million followers, we pride ourselves on quality, creativity and amazing service.

feeds.title: ASMR Toy Blog
feeds.description: ASMR Toy brings you a new way to experience ASMR that will help you relax, study, chill, meditate or help your sleep. With them, you can create your own sound mixes, choose among the great variety of high-quality ASMR sounds or a relaxing paper aeroplane, which can be anything from a plane to a spaceship. The blog gives you a varied range of articles on ASMR what-to, how-tos, 8D audio, and more.
